Senate.text: Referred to Agriculture, Veterans, Broadband, and Rural Development

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to noxious weeds; requiring notice of entry for noxious weed inspections; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 18.79, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 18.79, subdivision 3, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Entry upon land.
To administer and enforce sections 18.76 to 18.91, an inspector or county-designated employee may enter upon land without consent of the owner and without being subject to an action for trespass or any damages.[+ Before entering upon private land, an inspector or county-designated employee must notify the property owner via mail. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to noxious weeds; requiring notice of entry for noxious weed inspections; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 18.79, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 18.79, subdivision 3, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Entry upon land.
To administer and enforce sections 18.76 to 18.91, an inspector or county-designated employee may enter upon land without consent of the owner and without being subject to an action for trespass or any damages. Before entering upon private land, an inspector or county-designated employee must notify the property owner via mail.
additions: Before entering upon private land, an inspector or county-designated employee must notify the property owner via mail.
